articles.summary: Compugen Ltd. (Nasdaq: CGEN) (TASE: CGEN), a clinical-stage cancer immunotherapy company and a pioneer in computational target discovery powered by AI, today announced an oral presentation at the 18 th Annual Protein and Antibody Engineering Summit (PEGS) Europe, taking place November 16-19, 2026, in Lisbon, Portugal. The presentation will showcase UnigenX™, an expansion of the Company's computational discovery platform into targeted immune activation modalities, such as T cell engagers, designed to discover novel tumor-associated antigen targets and combinations for selective targeting of tumor cells. Title: UnigenX™: AI-Powered Discovery Platform for Novel Tumor-Associated Antigens for Targeted Immune Activation Track: Advancing Multispecific Antibodies and Combination Therapy to the Clinic Speaker: Dr. Roy Granit, Head of Computational Discovery at Compugen Date Time: Wednesday, November 18, 2026 at 18:30 GMT Link: PEGS Europe 2026 About Compugen
articles.title: Compugen to Present UnigenX™ Platform at the 18th Annual PEGS Europe Summit
